gloss: how much; to what extent; how far

definitions.gloss: how much; to what extent; how far
definitions.explanation: An interrogative or exclamatory adverb asking about the degree or extent of something. Can also be used rhetorically to emphasize a great degree.

examples.japanese: どれほど{待|ま}てばいいのか。
examples.english: How long do I have to wait?

examples.japanese: どれほど{大変|たいへん}だったか{想像|そうぞう}できる。
examples.english: I can imagine how hard it was.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}がどれほど{努力|どりょく}してきたか、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}はよく{知|し}っている。
examples.english: The people around her know well how much effort she has put in.

notes:
Composed of どれ (which/what) and ほど (degree/extent). Used both in genuine questions ('How much...?') and in rhetorical/emphatic statements to convey that something is to an impressive or significant degree. Slightly more literary than どのくらい.

USAGE PATTERNS:
- どれほど〜か: how much ~ (embedded question)
- どれほど〜ても: no matter how much ~
- どれほど〜ことか: how ~ it is! (exclamatory)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どれほど{嬉|うれ}しかったことか: how happy I was!
- どれほどの{価値|かち}があるか: how much value it has
- どれほど{時間|じかん}がかかるか: how long it takes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- どのくらい: how much / how long — the most common everyday equivalent
- いかほど: how much — more formal and literary
- どれだけ: how much — similar meaning, slightly more casual than どれほど
